title: Christmas at The Anchor, from small team dinners to big company parties
preheader: Six round a table or two hundred standing, and your own evening either way.

image.alt: A table laid for Christmas dinner at The Anchor

data.placeholder_caption: Christmas table laid up, warm low light
data.headline: From six round a table to the whole company
body: Whether it is a small team dinner or the big company party, we would like to get everyone celebrating this Christmas. Christmas dinner runs from 10 November to 20 December, from £23 a head.
We are a family-run village pub rather than a chain working through a Christmas template. Your group gets its own table and its own evening, never a shared sitting with another company.
data.cta_label: Check your date and get a quote

rows.label: Days
rows.value: Tuesday to Saturday, plus Sunday 1pm to 6pm. Never Mondays

rows.label: Group size
rows.value: 6 guests or more, up to 60 seated or 200 standing

rows.label: Deposit
rows.value: £10 per person, taken off your bill

data.body: The Anchor has served Stanwell Moor since 1751, and it is still run by a family rather than a head office. Your Christmas is not a template to us.

data.heading: What your team gets
body: Every adult gets a glass of prosecco, swappable for orange juice. Christmas dinner comes with pigs in blankets, stuffing, Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts.
list_items: Everyone picks their own courses, so the vegetarian is not an afterthought
Choices are made per guest as you book and go straight to the kitchen
A Christmas quiz runs through the season, and a DJ can be arranged on request

data.heading: Two ways to do it
data.body: Small teams book the sit-down Christmas menu. Bigger groups become a private hire, where the space is yours and we plan it around you.

image.alt: A small team sitting down to Christmas dinner at The Anchor

cards.heading: A team dinner
cards.body: From six guests up. Each person picks one, two or three courses for themselves, and chooses their dishes in advance.

image.alt: The Anchor set up for a large standing Christmas party

cards.heading: The whole company
cards.body: Up to 60 seated or 200 standing. Take a private space, add a festive buffet, or put the Christmas quiz on for them.

data.label: Thinking buffet?
data.body: The festive buffets are built for standing parties, and thirty guests is the minimum on all of them.

data.text: December Fridays and Saturdays go first.

data.heading: Organising this for work? The short answers

items.question: Can we get a VAT invoice?
items.answer: Yes, for corporate bookings, so expenses are straightforward.

items.question: Can we run a company bar tab?
items.answer: Yes, and you can set a spending limit on it. Just tell us when you book.

items.question: Will we be sharing with another company?
items.answer: No, never. Your group gets its own table and its own evening.

items.question: How do we collect everyone's meal choices?
items.answer: You pick them per guest as you book, and they reach the kitchen directly. They are due seven days before your date for the two and three course menus.

items.question: What about parking and getting there?
items.answer: Around 20 free spaces on site, outside the ULEZ, seven minutes from Terminal 5 and eight from Staines.

data.body: Tell us your date and rough numbers and we will come back to you within 24 hours. We need at least 24 hours notice, so there are no same-day Christmas bookings.
data.cta_label: Check your date and get a quote

data.ps_body: Choices are due seven days before your date for the two and three course menus, so the earlier it is in the diary, the less chasing you end up doing.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, or because you may be close to us and we thought this information would be helpful to you.
